studio.title: One screen, no digging
studio.one: The whole cockpit is one workspace around a live 3D twin, with the map, point cloud, LiDAR and cameras all in place.
studio.alt: Control Studio: the full workspace with the robot in a 3D point-cloud map, dock and timeline

hotspots.label: E-STOP
hotspots.what: Torque ON wakes the robot and reveals the controls; the same button is then the hard stop.

hotspots.label: Stiff | Soft
hotspots.what: Stiff tracks your commands; Soft lets the arms yield to a push.

hotspots.label: Record
hotspots.what: Records the session as a training episode for the current task.

hotspots.label: Drive · Task · Joint
hotspots.what: Picks what the controls move; 3rd | 1st swaps the camera.

hotspots.label: View rail
hotspots.what: Toggles map, point cloud, LiDAR, camera frusta, TF and paths.

hotspots.label: Cameras
hotspots.what: Head, front-base and both wrist cameras, live.

hotspots.label: Dock
hotspots.what: Status, Data, Skills: health, every joint, episodes, saved skills.

hotspots.label: Choreography
hotspots.what: Line up nav, policies, animations and poses; Preview in physics, then Execute.

studio.title: Fly it from its eyes
studio.one: First person from the head camera, with the twin tucked in a corner. Keyboard or on-screen sticks.
studio.alt: Control Studio in Drive mode, first person from the robot's head camera with two virtual sticks

hotspots.label: Drive
hotspots.what: The sticks and keys move the swerve base and the lift.

hotspots.label: 3rd | 1st
hotspots.what: 1st puts you behind the head camera; 3rd flies back out to the twin.

hotspots.label: TRANSLATE
hotspots.what: Slides the base forward, back and sideways at once.

hotspots.label: ROTATE · LIFT
hotspots.what: Turns on the spot and raises or lowers the whole body.

hotspots.label: Keyboard
hotspots.what: WASD drive, Q/E turn, R/F lift; click the floor to set a nav goal.

hotspots.label: 3D inset
hotspots.what: The twin keeps showing where the body is while you look through its eyes.

studio.title: Say where the hand goes
studio.one: Drag a target; the planner previews the arm on the twin, and nothing moves until you press Execute.
studio.alt: Control Studio in Task mode: a green wrist target beside the robot's hand and a wrist plan ready to execute

hotspots.label: Wrist target
hotspots.what: Drag the green ball; IK poses a preview on the twin, not the robot.

hotspots.label: Wrist plan · Execute
hotspots.what: Runs the previewed plan as a speed-capped, collision-checked move.

hotspots.label: IK reach
hotspots.what: How much body the solver may use: arm, upper body, or whole body with the base.

hotspots.label: Webcam Teleop
hotspots.what: Your own arms, tracked by any laptop camera, drive the robot's wrists.

hotspots.label: Wrist sticks
hotspots.what: Nudge each hand in the plane; ▲ ▼ raise and lower it.

studio.title: Every joint, at a glance
studio.one: The right-hand dock: robot health on top, then all 59 joints and their history.
studio.alt: Control Studio status dock: link, latency, battery and torque tiles, hardware chips, joint bars and trends

hotspots.label: Status · Data · Skills
hotspots.what: Live health, recorded episodes, and the saved skill library.

hotspots.label: Health tiles
hotspots.what: Link, round-trip latency, battery and torque, readable from across the room.

hotspots.label: Hardware
hotspots.what: One chip per module; green while it reports.

hotspots.label: Joint state · 59 DOF
hotspots.what: Current against target for every joint, coloured by motor temperature.

hotspots.label: Trends
hotspots.what: Rolling joint history per module, position, velocity or torque.

studio.title: Pop out what you need
studio.one: + Window floats extra views over the twin; drag and resize them anywhere.
studio.alt: Control Studio with floating MuJoCo viewer, joint history and TF tree windows and the + Window menu open

vp.title: The twin, in your room

vp.alt: Vision Pro Robot tab: the 3D twin in a map floating in a living room, drive pad below

hotspots.label: Status bar
hotspots.what: Link, latency, Reset, World, Home and the E-STOP, on every tab.

hotspots.label: Drive · Joint · Task

vp.title: Step in: your hands are its hands

vp.title: Spread the data around you
